incumbent_comparison: Better than best-so-far grapple-v004: v006 renders the raised gauge indices and hands that were absent from v004 and v005, while retaining the supported winch, distinct material groups, footprint, construction reveal, and working cable traversal.

observations.art_direction_fit: The actual production render reads as a steampunk grapple: a braced launcher, exposed gear train, rope winch, copper boiler, and enamel instruments in the intended small-scale style.
observations.close_up_quality: The detail and three-quarter captures show two readable enamel dials with raised indices, contrasting needles, brass hubs, and visible boiler seams; the gear teeth, shaft, and winding are also distinguishable.
observations.gameplay_readability: All three construction stages completed through autonomous work, the live cable deployed, FLOOR-to-DESK_TOP activated, and the receipt records a citizen traversal in progress.
observations.geometric_detail: The render shows distinct supported spool wheels and hubs, individual spokes, nine cable wraps, a linked secondary gear, pipework, vessel bands, round tower rails, and ladder collars.
observations.material_realism: Oiled timber, rough tan rope, forged dark iron, brass gearwork, copper vessel and plumbing, and pale enamel dials remain visually distinct in the actual room lighting.
observations.proportion: The complete installation remains a compact base-and-tower assembly at 9.0 by 11.58 by 7.5 inches, with the winch and launcher visually balanced.
observations.scale_fidelity: Godot reports the established 9.0 by 11.58 by 7.5 inch bounds; the original construction base, target, and navigation geometry remain in force.
observations.semantic_recognizability: The standard three-quarter and profile captures identify a rope-driven grapple launcher, and the far view shows it in the real construction site.
observations.silhouette_quality: The narrow braced launch tower rises above the broad supported winch base, giving a recognizable grapple-installation outline in matched cameras.
observations.surface_variation: Textured timber and rope contrast against iron, brass, and copper; the boiler seam rings, dial faces, joints, collars, and rope turns break up the larger forms.
observations.technical_integration: The challenger loads as a native PackedScene through the real stable-ID override, passes bounds/import validation at 236 meshes and 74,016 triangles, and leaves construction and traversal state to their existing systems.
